description: This Java source file defines the 'ContentManagementWorker' class, which provides a collection of static utility methods for managing content entities, including caching, permission checking, entity retrieval, publication point handling, and content statistics updates within the OFBiz content management system.

classes.name: ContentManagementWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for content management operations such as caching, permission verification, entity retrieval, publication point handling, and updating content statistics within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: mruAdd
methods.description: Adds an entity to the most recently used cache tied to the session.

methods.name: mruAddByEntityName
methods.description: Stores an entity's primary key signature in a LifoSet cache under its entity name.

methods.name: mostRecentlyViewedIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the most recently viewed entities of a specific type.

methods.name: buildPKSig
methods.description: Builds a unique string signature from a GenericEntity's primary key values, optionally appending a suffix.

methods.name: setCurrentEntityMap
methods.description: Stores the current entity instance in the session's currentEntityMap under its entity name.

methods.name: getFromSomewhere
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value from paramMap, request attribute, or context by name.

methods.name: getCurrentValue
methods.description: Determines and retrieves the current entity value and primary key based on request parameters or cache.

methods.name: getCurrentValueWithCachedPK
methods.description: Constructs a current primary key from request parameters and cache, and fetches the associated entity.

methods.name: getPermittedPublishPoints
methods.description: Verifies which publish points a user has permission to access based on provided security context.

methods.name: getAllPublishPoints
methods.description: Retrieves all publish points related to a parent publish point through ContentAssoc.

methods.name: getPublishPointMap
methods.description: Creates a map from content ID to publish point entities.

methods.name: getAllPublishPointMap
methods.description: Recursively populates a map with all publish points related to a parent content ID.

methods.name: getPublishPointMap
methods.description: Creates a map from a list of publish point entities keyed by content ID.

methods.name: getStaticValues
methods.description: Returns static value mappings for content associated with a parent placeholder, considering permitted publish points.

methods.name: getWebSitePublishPoint
methods.description: Retrieves a WebSitePublishPoint entity, using cache unless overridden, and handles inheritance from parent content.

methods.name: overrideWebSitePublishPoint
methods.description: Overrides a WebSitePublishPoint with data from its parent if available.

methods.name: getParentWebSitePublishPointValue
methods.description: Fetches the parent WebSitePublishPoint content value.

methods.name: getParentWebSitePublishPointId
methods.description: Determines the parent WebSitePublishPoint ID via ContentAssoc.

methods.name: getStaticValue
methods.description: Returns a specific static value entity, possibly using cache, based on placeholder ID.

methods.name: getPublishedLinks
methods.description: Retrieves a list of links to published content points related to a target content ID and root publish ID.

methods.name: getAuthorContent
methods.description: Fetches the author content related to a specific content ID.

methods.name: getPermittedDepartmentPoints
methods.description: Checks user permissions and returns department content points the user can access.

methods.name: getAllDepartmentContent
methods.description: Retrieves all department entities related to a parent publish point.

methods.name: getUserName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the user based on user login ID.

methods.name: updateStatsTopDown
methods.description: Recursively updates content statistics, counting children and updating counts upward.

methods.name: updateStatsBottomUp
methods.description: Updates content statistics bottom-up by propagating count changes to parent content.
